prompt:
ONE image divided into 3 CLEAR PANELS of equal size, arranged left to right in a horizontal row, separated by generous clean cream gutters with NO drawn borders and NO frame lines. Each panel is one beat of the same argument and they read in order.

THE COLOUR RULE, and it governs the whole image: WARM AMBER GLOW MEANS A LAYER IS SOUND. DEEP MUTED BRICK RED MEANS A LAYER HAS FAILED. The crack and every damaged thing are painted in a deep dull brick red, clearly and obviously a different colour from the warm amber. NOTHING about the crack or the damage is amber, gold, orange or yellow. The red is muted and earthy like old brick or dried rust, never bright, never neon, never glowing.

THE FIGURE, the same person in all three panels and recognizably the same person in each: a woman in her mid-forties, South Asian, short dark hair going grey at the temples, wearing a plain olive canvas work apron over a grey long-sleeved shirt. She is calm and absorbed in her work.

THE SETTING, one consistent world across all three panels: a warm workshop at dusk. On her bench sits a glowing translucent amber laptop, open, and a tall column of translucent panes rises up out of the laptop's screen like a lit column, so the layers live INSIDE the laptop while she works in the warm real room OUTSIDE it.

BEAT ONE: The column is a tall stack of many translucent panes, one resting on the next, rising up and continuing past the top edge of the panel so the top is not visible. Every pane glows warm amber, sound and unbroken, with no red anywhere in this panel. She stands at the bench at the very bottom, working with small hand tools on the lowest few panes only.

BEAT TWO: A jagged DEEP BRICK RED crack has torn through a pane HIGH up the column, near the top edge of the panel, far above her head. That high pane has lost its amber and gone dull red. The red crack runs downward through the panes below it. At the bottom, in her hands, the finished piece she has just lifted off the bench is split and warped and stained the same dull red. She is looking down at the ruined red piece in her hands and NOT looking up at the red crack. Her expression is puzzled. The undamaged panes stay amber, so the red reads as damage against them.

BEAT THREE: She has turned and is looking UP the column, raising a small warm lantern toward the high red crack to trace it. The red crack is still clearly red. Exactly THREE panes at the very bottom of the column, the ones beside her hands, glow bright sound amber, brighter and warmer than everything above. Every pane above those three is dim and out of her reach. Count carefully: exactly three bright amber panes at the base, no more and no fewer.

TEXT FURNITURE, in the cream margins only and never over the artwork. Reproduce every string character-exact and add no other lettering anywhere:
Title bar, centered in the cream margin ABOVE the panels, in caps: THE ALIGNMENT STACK
Caption in the cream gutter UNDER panel one, in caps: A STACK OF MANY LAYERS
Caption in the cream gutter UNDER panel two, in caps: THE CRACK STARTS HIGHER
Caption in the cream gutter UNDER panel three, in caps: YOU CAN REACH THREE
Footer bar, centered in the cream margin BELOW the panels, in caps: SYMPTOM AT THE BOTTOM, CAUSE NEAR THE TOP

Any other writable surface in frame is BLANK: no labels on the panes, no writing on the bench, no text on the laptop screen, no numbers anywhere.

ABSOLUTELY NOT: a denim jacket, a jean jacket, any chest patch, any smiley-face badge, any enamel pin, any embroidered emblem, a white tee under an open jacket. No recurring branded character and no identifiable real individual. No neon, no 3D or CGI rendering, no glossy plastic, no HUD or arc-reactor comic vocabulary, no power armor.

warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults

Do NOT render it in any of these styles: comic-book, cartoon mascot, flat vector, neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, photoreal, anime, any identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.
